spanish: Y dijo Moisés a ellos: Varón, no deje sobrar de él hasta mañana.

findings.issue: The suffix is first person common plural (from us); de él is third person masculine singular.
The noun is morning; hasta mañana means until tomorrow.
איש is the subject of a third-person masculine singular jussive; the comma makes Varón a direct address, so no deje can be read as usted.

notes: Y dijo Moisés a ellos matches the wayyiqtol, the name, and the third-person plural suffix.
